task.title: Cancel one pending schedule revision
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/833 by exposing revision-bound cancellation with exact caller-owned rationale through the CLI.
acceptance_criteria: Validate schedule identity and non-blank reason before storage access.
Cancel only the exact observed pending revision and emit the complete projection.
Reject stale, missing, or wrong-state requests without appending evidence.

attempts.diagnostic: Cancellation tests initially had no command implementation and failed at CLI parsing.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the required success, absence or conflict, validation, and fail-closed paths.

attempts.summary: Implemented the bounded contract and refactored only demonstrated duplication.
attempts.diagnostic: The capability existed below the requested boundary or required one new typed kernel operation.
attempts.patch: Added the exact-revision ScheduleStore::cancel adapter, stable diagnostics, persistence coverage, and complete JSON output.

outcome.summary: Callers can cancel one observed pending revision without clock, claim, dispatch, or execution authority.

lessons: Optimistic revision evidence belongs at the mutation boundary.
Rejected lifecycle transitions must append no plausible cancellation evidence.
